title: Create a modifier group + options with the right Required/Optional behavior
summary: Replicates Toast Web modifier-group creation including the behavior matrix (Required blocks sends; Optional can force a POS prompt) and the empty-group trap.

steps.title: Create the group (min 1 when required behavior is intended)
Add the option with price delta
Set Required vs Optional + Include a POS prompt
steps.instructions: On the group: Required forces a selection before the item can be sent; Optional shows the group only if "Include a POS prompt" is enabled — choose deliberately per service flow.

steps.title: Control display order if staff complain about prompt sequence
steps.instructions: Group Properties > Display Ordering Priority (1 = first), then Front of house > Order screen setup > UI options > Modifier Ordering Priority = Yes. Save and publish.

steps.title: Empty groups break online-ordering syncs — block them
